criteria.requirement: The executable validator rejects every exercised schema violation, including undeclared properties at every relevant object level, provider_state outside its enum, and result_transaction.state outside its enum. The comparison is systematic against the schema, not limited to three hand-picked examples.
All 23 seeded assertions pass unchanged. No seeded test assertion, fixture, or expected failure may be weakened, deleted, skipped, or rewritten to make the strengthened validator appear successful.

The strengthened validator is run against result documents already emitted by other cohorts. Any newly rejected document is reported with its immutable unit and reason; compatibility may not be silently assumed.

Each capsule entry binds path, blob SHA, and commit SHA and resolves bytes with read-only git plumbing. A fresh clone with no working tree produces byte-identical resolution, and a source change creates a new capsule version with explicit predecessor lineage.
The standalone preflight classifies CURRENT, DRIFTED, and MISSING; only CURRENT exits zero; all four real drift fixtures fail; a clean capsule passes; and the controller remains untouched.

The lineage reconciler derives frozen blob, current blob, and ordered causal commits from git history alone. It compares to the independently written drift evidence and emits a discrepancy on disagreement without editing or trusting that evidence as input.
Every claim has a committed executable artifact, complete result metadata, immutable read-back, and an independent reproducible command; unavailable units remain NOT_YET rather than being inferred.

decision_rule: REJECT if any mandatory criterion has an executable counterexample, a weakened seeded assertion, an unreported cross-cohort rejection, or an artifact that cannot be independently resolved from its immutable commit. ACCEPT only when every exercised criterion passes and all unexercised boundaries are explicitly NOT_YET.
attack_classes: schema/executable divergence beyond the three named cases
mutation that removes or weakens a seeded assertion
validator rejection of previously emitted result documents
working-tree capsule drift despite fixed commit
